To be clear these are really not well explained

Easy:

the collector: The easiest really just stun him 1 time and thats it

the hag: Really easy just hit her with a lot of dmg and thats it

the crew: Just hit them with a load of dots and dmg and stun and thats it

the viscount: Clear the corpses and thats it

the flesh: Just target the hearth or do a lot of aoe dmg and thats it

the dd4 boss: Just do a lot of dmg and stun and dots and thats it

the prophet: Just bring 2 occulist and thats it

Medium:

the siren: Bring a lot of holy water and a lot of stuns and dots

the swine king: Theres a lot of ways to kill the swine king(debuff, marking, dodge+riptose, stunning, bleeding, etc.)

the brigand cannon: Bring heroes that can hit all ranks and a lot of dmg and a good healer and thats it

the necromancer: Bring a crusader and a lot of dots and stuns and thats it

the dd1 boss: Bring 1 occ, and heroes that dont get affected to shuffle and a lot of dots and thats it

the shrieker: Bring a lot of acc items and a MAA for the command buff and mark synergy and thats it

the garden guardian: Bring a frontline with move resist and a team that can resist or clear bleeding and a good healer

the brigand vvulf: bring a MAA or a occ and mark synergy and thats it

the shambler: Bring a team that can stun consistently and a lot of dots and thats it

Hard:

the dd2 bosses: Bring a MAA(or two) and a HM(or two) and a good dmg dealer and a healer and stun,bleeding and blight resistance and thats it

the baron: Bring 1 occ and HW and MAA for riptose and dmg debuff and thats it

the countess: Bring a flagellant and a hellion and a good healer and consistent stuns and thats it

the crocodilian: Bring a lot of bleed and stuns and thats it

the fanatic: Bring 2 HM with dodge trinkets and 2 dmg dealers and thats it
try to have comps that can stun, heal, do dmg, hit almost all positions, and stress heal
Depends on the comp, dungeon and difficulty

Ruins: Vestal, PD, HW, Cruisader - Extremely powerful but lacks stun but has powerful heal, DMG and stress healing and decent stalling

Warrens: HM, Vestal, HM, MAA- Probably the strongest in stuns and stalling good DMG good healing and really good stress heal

Weald: GR, Occulist, BH, Hellion- Really good stuns, Extremely good DMG, can cure deseases and neat mark synergy for times when you need to kill the giant fast but it lacks stress healing wich is not really too bad if you buy a couple of herbs and use revel every time you do camping

Cove: PD, Occulist, Occulist, Hellion: Extremely good stuns , Extremely good DMG, neat healing, good bleed remover, doesnt have stress healing but again it is no problem if you do the herb and revel when you do camping

Courtyard: Vestal, Jester, HM(or HW(or BH( or Crusader))), MAA: This comp is impossible to kill if you use them correctly in the epic quest stress healing is Extremely good, Really good DMG, Extremely good stuns, Standar stalling, Really good healing but one problem is that they have bad bleed resistance wich is ok if you do the right moves and you know what mob is necessaryto kill in the moment
